acceptanceCriteria: The AFP-V0-066 advisory uses the NGI-V0-052 gem-declaration check, with a Minitest-with-spec/ fixture test
AFP-V0-066 is amended; spec-requirements-check and focused tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1805 (PR #1145). NGI-V0-052 requires rspec, rspec-core or rspec-rails to be declared in the committed Gemfile or Gemfile.lock before naming bundle exec rspec. The affected advisory RSpec check (AFP-V0-066) still keys only on a root Gemfile. The risk is lower because it is keyed on ruby:rspec: units, but the two surfaces disagree. Expected: both use the same bounded gem-declaration check. Observed in PR #1145, 2026-10-18.
title: Affected advisory RSpec check (AFP-V0-066) checks only for a root Gemfile, not a declared rspec gem; inconsistent with NGI-V0-052
